div.head: I As Prol.
div.ab: Ic Æþelstan cyng, mid geþehte Wulfhelmes [mines] arcebiscopes ⁊ eac minra oþerra biscopa, cyþe þam gerefan to gehwylcere byrig ⁊ eow bidde on Godes naman ⁊ on ealra his haligra ⁊ eac be minum freondscipe beode, þæt ge ærest of minum agenum góde agyfan þa teoþunga, ægþer ge on cwicum ceape ge on þæs geares eorðwæstmum, swa man rihtast mæge oððe gemetan oððe getellan oððe awegan; ⁊ þa biscopas þonne þæt ylce don on heora agenum gode, ⁊ mine ealdormen ⁊ mine gerefan þæt sylfe.

I, King Æthelstan, with the advice of my archbishop Wulfhelm, and my other bishops also, inform the reeve in every borough, and pray you in the name of God and all of His saints, and command you also by my friendship, that in the first place you render tithes of my own property, both in livestock and in the yearly fruits of the earth, measuring, counting and weighing [them] in accordance with the strictest accuracy. And the bishops shall do the same with their own property, and my ealdormen and my reeves likewise.

Æðelstan cyningc mid geþeahte Wulfhelm arcebiscop ⁊ eac minra oðera biscopa, cyð ðam gerefan to hwilcere birig ⁊ eow bidde on Godes naman ⁊ on eallum his haligra ⁊ eac be minum freondscipe, þæt ge ærest of minum agenum gode agifan ða teoðunga, ægðer ge on cwicum ceape ge on ðæs geares eorðwæstmum, swa man rihtost mage oððe gemetan oððe getellan oððe awegan; ⁊ þa biscopas þonne þæt ilce don on heora agenum gode, ⁊ mine ealdormen ⁊ mine gerefan þæt silfe.
